info.name: Abstract API Avatars Image Processing API
Abstract API Process Image by URL

params.name: api_key
params.description: Your unique API key for the Image Processing API.

params.name: url
params.description: URL of the image to process.

params.name: lossy
params.description: Whether to apply lossy compression. Defaults to true.

params.name: quality
params.description: Image quality from 1 to 100 (for lossy compression).

params.name: output_format
params.description: Target output format (jpeg, png, webp, gif).

items.docs: Compress, convert, or optimize an image from a given URL.
